verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only JavaScript source map upload and un-minification, and Cocoa crash reporting without any mention of symbol upload. Nothing documents uploading dSYM, ProGuard/R8 mapping files, or native debug symbols, so mobile and native crash symbolication is unevidenced. JS source maps belong to a different story and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can upload dSYM, ProGuard, and native debug symbols so mobile and native crashes symbolicate to real function names and lines
